title: getPendingUpdateBreakdown request
description: GET /v1/engagements/{engagementId}/pending-update/breakdown - request. Per-intermediate-version breakdown of the cumulative offer (RF-050).
$comment: Source: DISENO S7 (d) GetPendingUpdateBreakdownQuery, (e), 3.8.6 BreakdownStep, DEC-34; S3 EngagementPendingUpdate.intermediateVersions; SX-01b (S2 GET /v1/summaries per pair); PRD RF-050. Audience: PUBLIC. Residency: REGIONAL engagement lookup + global TEMPLATE_PUBLIC summaries. Idempotency: safe read (GET); a missing step summary triggers GenerateChangeSummary.v1. Pagination: none (bounded by the intermediate versions).

headers.description: Contract-relevant request headers (platform/transport headers are out of scope). correlation-id is optional from the UI (generated by ms-experience-gateway when missing, DISENO 3.8.5) and mandatory on service-to-service and operator calls (propagation, RF-120).
